Generate a NEW image rendering the SAME cropped area at substantially higher native detail and resolution, at least 1536 pixels across if available. Aspect ratio about 666:590. Do not extend the crop or show surrounding quadrants. Preserve the exact framing, relative scale, every coastline, watercourse, existing building cluster and major terrain feature. CRITICAL: the outer 10% rim on all four edges must match the reference composition and colors so it can transition into adjacent atlas sections. Do not add a frame or empty margin. Increase fine ground-level cartographic detail in the interior, rather than merely sharpening or enlarging pixels: small tree crowns and roots, moss, stone joints, field hedges, small rock strata, shore shallows and water texture as appropriate. Floating islands and ancient forest: densely detailed emerald canopies, luminous blue-green knots and hollows, gnarled roots, maintained living wood/stone settlement architecture at the bottom edge, moss gardens and suspended walkways. Northern dry plateau rocky strata. Volcano at right edge only; preserve its cutoff. No additional buildings or named sites. Beautiful hand-painted children's fantasy atlas, saturated emerald/teal and warm ochre, crisp legible terrain, painterly illustrative cartography matching the reference. No text, names, symbols, UI, compass, border, people or arbitrary new roads. Routes are a vector overlay in the game. This is not a new composition: all large features stay where the reference puts them. Entire output is the cropped map area.
